lines.zh: 我一步能压塌一块石头。
lines.en: One step of mine can crush a stone.
My tread falls heavier than a hammer.
Grass snaps in two under my feet.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但你跑不掉。
lines.en: I am not fast, but you cannot outrun me.

lines.zh: 每步都先掂量你的位置。
lines.en: Each step measures where you stand.
The ground knows I have come.

lines.zh: 我的影子先压到你身上。
lines.en: My shadow reaches you before I do.
My muscles creak as I walk.

lines.zh: 这双腿适合砸，不适合追。
lines.en: These legs are for slamming, not chasing.
Do not stand near where I come down.
I walk slowly to give you time to think.
Dust follows behind me.

lines.zh: 我把拳头在胸口敲了两下。
lines.en: I tap both fists against my chest.
Four ways to strike; I have not chosen.
Stone sits in my grip like mud.
I am counting the cracks in this ground.
The plates on my shoulders hardened again.
Dust rises when I breathe.
I am deciding which side to crush first.
The ground here breaks far too easily.

lines.zh: 四分之一的机会，慢慢猜。
lines.en: One chance in four; keep guessing.

lines.zh: 安静，我在听地下的空腔。
lines.en: Quiet; I am listening for hollow ground.
The top of your head reaches my knee.
I am watching where you put your feet.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛比你的腿诚实。
lines.en: Your eyes are more honest than your legs.

lines.zh: 别移开，我要记住你的姿势。
lines.en: Do not look away; I want your stance memorized.

lines.zh: 你也想试试我的重量吗？
lines.en: Care to test my weight?

lines.zh: 你站得这么近，我闻得到汗。
lines.en: Standing this close, I can smell your sweat.

lines.zh: 你看我时，喉咙动了一下。
lines.en: Your throat moved while you looked at me.

lines.zh: 看清楚了，我只有四种打法。
lines.en: Look closely; I only have four strikes.
Your eyes say you want to circle behind.

lines.zh: 我记住了你眨眼的样子。
lines.en: I noted the way you blink.
Your blade slides off my plates.
Eight layers of plate; your hands must be numb.
It stings, but the ground hurts more.

lines.zh: 这一下没打断我的重心。
lines.en: That did not break my balance.
You found the seam on my shoulder.
My blood drips and stains the soil black.
I stepped back half a pace and the ground sank.

lines.zh: 你的力气比我想的大一点。
lines.en: You hit a little harder than I expected.
Do not cheer; I can still slam ten times.

lines.zh: 这伤口正好给我个理由。
lines.en: This wound gives me a good reason.
Food for your life? Not heavy enough.
I eat stone, not bread.

lines.zh: 把它扔进坑里，我看不见。
lines.en: Throw it into the pit where I cannot see.

lines.zh: 我的手太大，抓不住麦子。
lines.en: My hands are too big for wheat.
What you hold is far too small.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候会砸墙，不吃草。
lines.en: Hungry, I smash walls; I do not graze.
That meat will not fill a gap in my teeth.
Food is worth less than a hard rock.
Put it away; it is too soft for me.
If you feed me, stand well back first.

lines.zh: 你的冲劲全被我的甲吃掉。
lines.en: My plates swallowed your whole charge.
After that bump, your shoulder sits crooked.
Do not push; my shoulder has eight layers.

lines.zh: 你撞到的地方在发麻吧。
lines.en: The spot you hit is numb now, is it not?
You cannot shove me even standing still.

lines.zh: 这一撞震动传到了地下。
lines.en: That impact reached the ground below.
Move; this is where I put my feet.

lines.zh: 你的骨头比我预想的脆。
lines.en: Your bones are more brittle than I guessed.
Squeeze in and you fall into my crater.
One bump and the dust jumps.

lines.zh: 繁殖？我这体型不好找伴。
lines.en: Breeding? This size makes mates scarce.
My kind greet each other with fists.

lines.zh: 伴侣挡不住我一次砸地。
lines.en: A mate could not survive one slam.

lines.zh: 我不需要谁来分我的地盘。
lines.en: I need no one to share my ground.
My offspring would grow harder than me.
Mating can wait until the fight ends.
Asking that — buying time?
This land holds only one beast.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的胳膊会甩。
lines.en: Do not come close; my arms swing wide.
Go away; I do not want to flatten you.
This cobble will serve as a hammer head.
That hard stone fits my hand.
Stand back when I bend down.
This pile of rubble is mine.

lines.zh: 你掉的盾太轻，我拿不住。
lines.en: Your dropped shield is too light to grip.
I pick things up the way I smash.
This rock can open a wall.
Leave it; one step flattens it.
I lift one rock and drop it.

lines.zh: 地上的东西硌脚，我捡走。
lines.en: This thing stubs my foot; I take it away.
You stood on soft ground; bad luck.

lines.zh: 四种打法里有一种适合你。
lines.en: One of my four strikes suits you.
Four legs will not outlast one of my steps.
When my shoulders drop, you should run.

lines.zh: 你的护甲看起来能撑两下。
lines.en: Your armor looks good for two hits.

lines.zh: 你靴底沾着湿泥，跑不快。
lines.en: Wet mud on your boots will slow you.
You are inside my landing zone.
Ground first, then you.

lines.zh: 你退得越远，我砸得越深。
lines.en: The farther you retreat, the deeper I crack.
This patch of ground gets turned over today.
I pick you because you did not run.
Do not hide behind that wall; it is soft.
My fists are already closed.
The ground under you goes first.

lines.zh: 你身后那堵墙，我一步就能穿。
lines.en: The wall behind you is one step through.

lines.zh: 这么近，四种打法都够得着。
lines.en: This close, all four of my strikes can reach.
My foot is up; watch closely.

lines.zh: 砸地要两秒，你只有两秒。
lines.en: The slam takes two seconds; so do you.
You go left; I crack left.
The stones will fly up and bite you.
The ground beneath your feet is splitting.

lines.zh: 我不看你的手，我看你的脚。
lines.en: I watch your feet, not your hands.

lines.zh: 四分之一的机会，你不一定躲开。
lines.en: One in four; you may not dodge it.
Retreat to a corner and I hit easier.
The ground is carrying word of me.
Listen; the dirt is groaning.

lines.zh: 这一下砸的是硬度最低的砖。
lines.en: This blow targets the softest brick.
Do not jump; jumping makes you easier.
When this foot lands, the floor gives way.
Last step — now.

lines.zh: 我数到两，你的脚就得离地。
lines.en: I count to two, and your feet leave the ground.

lines.zh: 泥土在抖，那是我的节奏。
lines.en: The soil shakes. That is my rhythm.
Walk by the wall; the wall cracks first.

lines.zh: 我抬起双臂，阴影落在你身上。
lines.en: I raise both arms; my shadow falls on you.

lines.zh: 你往哪边躲，我都砸得到。
lines.en: Whichever way you dodge, I can still hit.

lines.zh: 这一下先试你的护甲厚度。
lines.en: This first blow tests your armor.
Slam; the stones leap up.
This punch is fifteen points; enough.
I punched straight through the bricks.
The shockwave shoved you aside.
I swing wide; you dodged late.
The ground has a dent in it now.
I saw the seam in your armor.
This one goes for the knee.
I strike when you land.
The clods arrive before my fist.
I stamp the slab under your feet.

lines.zh: 这一击把木门砸成两半。
lines.en: This blow split the wooden door.
You backed off, but the ground still shakes.
One more and you should be down.

lines.zh: 我横着扫，把你从地上掀起来。
lines.en: I sweep sideways and lift you off the ground.

lines.zh: 拳落在你胸口，你喘不上气。
lines.en: My fist lands on your chest; you cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你退进了碎石堆。
lines.en: This shove puts you back into the rubble.

lines.zh: 我踩下去，你的脚陷进泥里。
lines.en: I stamp down; your foot sinks into mud.

lines.zh: 木头碎裂的声音，我听过很多次。
lines.en: I have heard wood break many times.

lines.zh: 你举盾的手在抖，我看见了。
lines.en: The hand on your shield shakes. I saw it.

lines.zh: 我从跃者的尸体上站起来。
lines.en: I rose from a leaper's corpse.
Bones grew first; muscle followed.
My first step cracked the ground.
Shoulder plates pushed up through my hide.
I opened my eyes and everything shook.
This weight is new to me.

lines.zh: 附近没有东西值得我砸。
lines.en: Nothing nearby is worth smashing.

lines.zh: 四种打法已经刻在骨里。
lines.en: Four strikes are carved into my bones.

lines.zh: 我从孢子堆里爬得很慢。
lines.en: I crawled slowly out of the spore heap.
The air makes my shoulders creak.
I stood up, and the trees grew short.
One slam first, to test my strength.
Fire on my hide like roasting stone.
I landed and the crater deepened two blocks.
The water is shallow; my head stays above.
The blast moved me half a step.
The arrow sticks in a seam like a thorn.

lines.zh: 法术在我身上散成火星。
lines.en: The spell scatters into sparks on my hide.
Hunger has drained my swing.
Lightning struck and I took it as a massage.
No ground here; I cannot slam.
